sourceNote: Printed page 224. The "Glossary and Notes" continue: the first entry completes the last entry of the previous page ("impersonal devotion … single task without any allowance …") and twenty further entries follow, printed as run-in headings (shown here as a two-column table). The printed notes contain several typos ("attach" for "attack", "is infect" for "in fact", "their would be not ultimatum", "tuming"), which are kept as printed. The Urdu and Pashto texts are translations by us. A phone-number strip, the watermark and border lines are excluded; pink corner flags are excluded. The page number 224 is printed in a diamond at the foot.
